articles.title: Lamine Yamal hilariously trolls Nico Williams
articles.summary: Lamine Yamal knows how to have fun, and he proved it during the international break by teasing his friend Nico Williams. While the two were riding in a small shuttle, Yamal noticed Nico had a noticeably sweaty armpit and quickly turned the moment into a joke. He posted the clip to Instagram and tagged AXE, giving the deodorant brand an unexpected shoutout. The video quickly went viral, with fans loving the perfectly timed prank and another glimpse at the playful friendship between the two Spanish stars.

articles.title: Emergency summit over the Cristiano mess: intervention by the Portuguese Federation
articles.standfirst: The forward met on Tuesday night with Jorge Jesus and the federation president to try to put out the fire after being benched
articles.summary: The forward met on Tuesday night with Jorge Jesus and the federation president to try to put out the fire after being benched
articles.body:
Jorge Jesus and Cristiano Ronaldo met on Tuesday night at the Portuguese national team's training camp hotel in Malmö (Sweden).

The meeting, confirmed by A Bola, served to address the situation that arose after the last match against Norway . According to what this Portuguese newspaper learned, the conversation between the national team coach and the Portuguese captain took place in a positive manner and left favorable impressions, with the intention of easing the tension that has settled within the national team.

The origin of the unrest lies in the decision to leave Cristiano Ronaldo on the bench throughout the match played in Oslo . At first, the striker was informed that he would not get any minutes in that match. Later, Jorge Jesus told him that the plan was to bring him on in the second half for approximately half an hour. Ronaldo even went through warm-up exercises, but in the end he did not step onto the pitch . After the final whistle, the Portuguese star clearly showed his anger and headed straight for the dressing room.

Since then, Cristiano has not taken part in training with the group and has only worked in the gym. His situation has caused some unease within the national team and has once again brought to the table the debate about his role as the team's captain.

The matter was addressed directly by Cristiano Ronaldo and Jorge Jesus on Tuesday night, while Pedro Proença , president of the Portuguese Federation, who had planned to travel to the Azores to watch the under-21 national team face Gibraltar , chose to remain in Copenhagen to deal with the situation involving the senior national team, which will face Denmark tomorrow on matchday three of the Nations League.

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo leaves Portugal's training camp!!!
articles.standfirst: After Jorge Jesus's words denying any problem
articles.summary: After Jorge Jesus's words denying any problem
articles.body:
Bombshell from Denmark: Cristiano Ronaldo leaves Portugal’s training camp and will board his private plane to Madrid in a matter of hours. The captain and great icon of the Portuguese national team is leaving after his coach’s comments about his absence from the matches against Norway and Denmark. An early goodbye to this UEFA Nations League break (there were two matches left) that could be CR7’s final farewell to the Portuguese national team.

A situation that escalated in a matter of minutes shortly after Jorge Jesus, Portugal’s current national team coach and his former manager at Al Nassr (with whom he won the Saudi league), said there was no problem whatsoever with CR7.

What's more, he had even stated that he would train today in Copenhagen: "Yesterday he did not refuse to train. Francisco Conceição did not train due to injury, nor did Félix, because we were trying to ease the fatigue, and Cristiano Ronaldo did gym work. He will train today. It is the fourth day, so he will train." But no. The captain left Parken in a black van belonging to the Portuguese Football Federation.

If I need you for 30 minutes, you will play; if not, you won't. No player will make me change my mind

'Jorge Jesus, moreover, had confirmed a meeting with Cristiano last night, Tuesday, but made it clear that everything had been resolved before dinner time. However, he made his position of authority at the helm of the national team very clear: "I can promise whatever I want. I am the coach. I am the coach, I told the player that he was not going to play. I will put you on the bench. If I need you for 30 minutes, you will play; if not, you will not. No player will make me change my mind. Not him, nor anyone in football. Nor any president. Never, absolutely nobody".'

The origin of the controversy

Everything started a few days ago, in Oslo. Specifically during the Norway 1-2 Portugal Nations League match. Cristiano started on the bench and Jorge Jesus handed the starting spots to Joao Félix and Gonçalo Ramos. It worked out well for him because both scored and the team won... but that was when the crisis began.

The Portuguese captain remained on the bench throughout the entire match, except for moments in the second half when he was warming up... but he ended up without any minutes. After the victory, CR7 headed immediately to the dressing room and did not join the other substitutes in training the following day. Something that Jorge Jesus justified a few hours ago as something "usual" for the man from Madeira.

But what raised all the alarms in Portugal was the change of plans and trip by Pedro Proença, president of the Portuguese Football Federation, to meet in Copenhagen with the Portuguese star and national team coach Jorge Jesus. A meeting that took place this Wednesday morning.

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo's statement about his departure: "In due time, I will tell the truth..."
articles.standfirst: The Portuguese has confirmed it on his social media
articles.summary: The Portuguese has confirmed it on his social media
articles.body:
While his private jet flies to Copenhagen and he waits in Denmark to fly to Madrid, Cristiano Ronaldo issued a statement about his decision to leave the Portugal national team camp on the eve of the Nations League match against Denmark.

The statement from Cristiano Ronaldo:

After the national team's coach's press conference, and following a conversation with the president of the Portuguese Football Federation, I decided to leave the national team's training camp.

In due course I will tell all the Portuguese the truth about the reasons that led me to leave the national team to which I always devoted myself

' In due time I will tell all Portuguese people the truth about the reasons that led me to leave the National Team, to which I always devoted myself. Now is the time to wish Portugal and all my teammates, without exception, good luck".'

Despite the words of CR7, Portugal's all-time top scorer and the footballer with the most international caps, the Portuguese is not referring to a definitive farewell to the National Team... simply to this break of four Nations League matches.

Let's remember that the man from Madeira left Copenhagen's Parken just a few minutes after the conclusion of a Jorge Jesus press conference in which the national team coach had stated that there was no problem with the player.

articles.title: The reasons behind Cristiano's anger with Jorge Jesus: will this be his farewell to Portugal?
articles.standfirst: MARCA reveals to you the minute-by-minute breakdown of the falling-out between player and coach
articles.summary: MARCA reveals to you the minute-by-minute breakdown of the falling-out between player and coach
articles.body:
Cristiano was not just anyone, and it is being proven. Jorge Jesus, despite everything and all the rumors that existed, decided to call him up for these four matches . But what has made Cristiano Ronaldo angry? What has the chronology of events been like? Could these be Cris's final hours with his country?

1. Jorge Jesus calls up Cristiano and they agree that number 7 would play the first match (Wales, 1-0) and the fourth (against Norway on October 4). So far, so good, and Cris started against Wales, playing the first 66 minutes, scoring a goal... but it was disallowed. So far, everything was fine.

'2. On the morning of the second match against Norway (1-2), Jorge Jesus changes his mind and tells Cristiano that he needs him for that match and that he might give him the last half hour of the game. What happens? The match was 1-1 in the 51st minute with a goal by Haaland. Cris starts warming up, Portugal goes 1-2 up in the 54th minute, and the match situation no longer allows the No. 7 to play because they have to hold on to the result. He warms up for half an hour, does not come on, and leaves the stadium angry.'

3. He does not train before the match and goes to the hotel. Cristiano, yesterday Tuesday, did not train with the group in Denmark and goes to the hotel while the training session takes place. He trains alone in the gym.

' 4. JJ's press conference makes Cris explode. The star listens to his coach's press conference, his explanations do not convince him -"it's a moment of frustration that lasts 10, 15 or 20 seconds," JJ said- and, far from training with the group, he leaves the training camp. He will take his private plane to Madrid, and will arrive tonight.'

5. Will it be his farewell to the National Team? Hard to know now, since this is all very recent. But the 146 goals in 234 matches by the No. 7 may have come to an end in Portugal.

articles.title: The consequences Cristiano Ronaldo faces after leaving the Portuguese national team
articles.standfirst: According to the regulations of the Portuguese Federation, he could be suspended for six months and fined financially.
articles.summary: According to the regulations of the Portuguese Federation, he could be suspended for six months and fined financially.
articles.body:
Cristiano Ronaldo left the Portugal national team training camp after Jorge Jesus's press conference, in which the national team coach defended his authority to decide the lineups . After these words from the coach, CR7 headed to Madrid from Copenhagen on his private plane. A decision that, beyond the fact that CR7 may not return to the national team, as O Jogo points out, could have consequences for him.

According to the Disciplinary Regulations of the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF) , Cristiano risks a sanction that may include a suspension of between one and six months and a financial fine.

"Any player who, having been duly called up, unjustifiably leaves or fails to attend a training session, a match or any activity of the national teams or related to the sporting representation of the FPF or Portugal, shall be sanctioned with a suspension from one to six months and, additionally, if the player is a professional, with a fine of between 5 and 10 UCs [between approximately 500 and 1,000 euros, with 102 euros per unit of account]," the regulations state.

'Furthermore, the second paragraph of article 160 of the FPF Regulations states the following: "Absence or abandonment entail the automatic preventive suspension of the player under the terms established in these regulations," the text adds.'

Two statements without explanations

Officially, the Portuguese Football Federation confirmed on Wednesday afternoon in a statement that Cristiano was leaving the training camp, but without explaining the reasons , and assured that preparations for the matches against Denmark and Norway would continue as planned with the other 24 called-up players. "The entire delegation remains fully focused on the national team's upcoming commitments and on achieving the defined objectives," the body stated.

Cristiano , for his part, also spoke out through social media, where he stated that he will explain the reasons later on for making the decision to leave.

In due time I will tell all the Portuguese the truth about the reasons that led me to leave the national team

"After the national team coach's press conference, and following a conversation with the president of the Portuguese Football Federation, I decided to leave the National Team's training camp. In due course i will tell all Portuguese people the truth about the reasons that led me to leave the national team to which I have always devoted myself. Now is the time to wish Portugal and all my teammates, without exception, good luck," wrote CR7.

articles.title: Pochettino activates ‘Team USA 2030’: Cavan Sullivan, Mathis Albert, Julian Hall…
articles.standfirst: The United States squad for this September international break has an average age of under 23 years old
articles.summary: The United States squad for this September international break has an average age of under 23 years old
articles.body:
All it takes is to look at the medal tables of each edition of the Olympic Games to see that, globally, there is no greater sporting power than the United States. ‘Soccer’ was one of the few remaining unfinished subjects. Mauricio Pochettino , however, has already begun to activate his ‘Team USA’ with an eye on the 2030 World Cup.

United States , although they went from more to less until falling in the round of 16 against Belgium with the Balogun scandal in between, managed to lay the foundations for what they hope will be a long-term project. They finished top of their group, advanced through a knockout round for the first time since Korea and Japan 2002 , and recorded their highest number of goals (11) in a single edition of the World Cup. All of this, moreover, while playing quite attractive football… relying on what has been dubbed Pochettino's 'pentagon'.

“It wasn’t the way we wanted to finish, but it’s something we can learn from going forward,” reflected the Argentina coach. “In one year, this team showed that it can play football and compete. We still need to keep improving. But there are many players with potential and a generation of youngsters coming through behind them. It’s about continuing to believe,” he warned.

There are many players with potential and a generation of young players coming through

His first post-World Cup World Cup squad featured notable absences: Balogun, Pulisic, McKennie, Johnny Cardoso, Tim Weah, Tessman... However, taking into account that the United States was not going to play any official competition matches, he realized it was the ideal time to start integrating some of the members of that promising crop the country is managing to produce. In fact, the average age of this call-up does not exceed 23 years.

“It is a completely different approach from the past. The World Cup is in four years. We need to work with different objectives and goals. If you look at Lamine Yamal , Spain won the World Cup with an 18-year-old boy. You think: ‘No, he’s too young. He needs more experience.’ Why? He’s the best,” explained Pochettino . “If we have players of the same age —16, 17, 18, 19— and they are good… Then why not? It’s about giving them the opportunity and having them take advantage of it. That is the mentality we want to build in this process.”

The leading figure of this new generation is surely Cavan Sullivan (Philadelphia, 2009) , who already has an agreement to join Manchester City when he comes of age. At just 14 years old, this teenager surpassed Freddy Adu as the youngest debutant in MLS history. Two years later, now established in the ranks of Philadelphia Union , he is living up to expectations… to the point of earning his first call-up with the United States after being involved in 12 goals since the competition resumed after the World Cup.

"He deserves all the praise he is receiving. He is performing well, providing assists and scoring goals at 16 years old," said Pochettino . "The important thing is to be with him and try to provide him with a solid platform to lean on. He still needs to show more, improve, evolve and mature," he added.

'Cavan Sullivan, however, is not the only prospect who has emerged with the United States during this break. Against Chile , Mathis Albert (Greenville, 2009) surpassed Pulisic as the youngest debutant in the history of the national team... just a few months after becoming the third-youngest player in Borussia Dortmund. Julian Hall (New York, 2008) , for his part, has found the net in the friendlies played so far by the team of "the stars and stripes".'

To them, we must also add Justin Ellis (Orlando City/2007), Brooklyn Raines (New England/2005), Adri Mehmeti (RB New York/2009), Zavier Gozo (Crystal Palace/2007), Frankie Westfield (Philadelphia Union/2005), Neil Pierre (Philadelphia Union/2007), Peyton Miller (New England/2007), Diego Kochen (Lyngby BK/2006), and Brian Schwake (Nashville/2001). In total, as many as 12 players have made their debut for the United States during this FIFA international window.

The balance is the most important thing and one of our responsibilities is to protect these kids

Pochettino , even so, calls for calm. "You have to be careful because, when you are young, you need self-confidence... but there is a limit. Balance is the most important thing and one of our responsibilities is to protect these boys because, sometimes, if you play well, you are 16,17 or 18 years old and people start talking as if you were Messi... if you get confused and do not manage it well, it can be dangerous". Excitement is through the roof with his "Team USA 2030".

articles.title: Roma says “no” and leaves Dybala and Molina without Messi's farewell with Argentina
articles.standfirst: AFA wanted to bring together the world champions from Qatar 2022 to accompany the Argentine captain against Benin, but Roma decided that its two footballers should prioritize local commitments and remain in Italy.
articles.summary: AFA wanted to bring together the world champions from Qatar 2022 to accompany the Argentine captain against Benin, but Roma decided that its two footballers should prioritize local commitments and remain in Italy.
articles.body:
"P aulo Dybala and Nahuel Molina will not be at Lionel Messi's farewell with the Argentina national team. Roma decided not to authorize the trip of its two footballers to Buenos Aires for the tribute prepared on October 6 at the Monumental.

The decision has a particular feature: neither of them was supposed to travel to play in the friendly against Benin. Both had been invited by the AFA as members of the squad that won the World Cup in Qatar 2022, as part of a celebration intended to bring together Messi’s former teammates and their families.

A trip outside the call-up

Since he was not part of the official squad call-up for the match, his presence in Buenos Aires depended on permission from Roma . The Italian club decided not to grant it and publicly explained the reasons.

'“ AS Roma announces that Paulo Dybala and Nahuel Molina will not participate in the event organized in Argentina for the match between Argentina and Benin on October 6”, the club reported .'

Roma indicated that the decision is due to “sporting and logistical reasons”. The club focused on the length of the intercontinental trip and the proximity of its upcoming official commitments.

The schedule helps explain the Italian team’s position. Roma will visit Como on October 11 for Serie A, just five days after the tribute in Buenos Aires. In addition, the side managed by Gian Piero Gasperini will host Real Madrid on October 14 in the Champions League .

Roma also made it clear that its decision does not imply downplaying the tribute. In the same statement, it expressed its “greatest respect for Lionel Messi and for his extraordinary career” and wished him a special night together with the Argentine Football Association .

articles.title: Jorge Jesus "will explain everything after the last match" following Cristiano's "departure"
articles.standfirst: The Portuguese coach spoke ahead of the match against Denmark
articles.summary: The Portuguese coach spoke ahead of the match against Denmark
articles.body:
'Cristiano Ronaldo's escape has caused such a rift in Portugal that the match against Denmark has taken a back seat. Everyone is eagerly waiting to find out what Jorge Jesus will say at the press conference after the match. Minutes before the ball got rolling, however, he gave a "flash" interview to "whet the appetite".'

"I will explain everything after the last match. I have been in football for many years and I know I did nothing that should have caused things to be different," he said. "After the match against Norway , we will talk about this issue. I will not hide from it or run away from it".

Jorge Jesus , therefore, urged the media to put the matter aside. At least until he had finished a first international break that was tremendously turbulent at the start of his tenure as the new Portugal manager. However, it will be impossible for the press conference not to revolve solely and exclusively around the figure of Cristiano .

The Portuguese coach, however, wanted to tone down the tense atmosphere that has arisen in recent hours after he missed Tuesday's training session and decided to head to Madrid as a result of what he heard at yesterday's press conference. "No one can take away what Cristiano represents. He is an icon and that is not something that can be debated," he clarified.

articles.summary: Press conference of the Spanish national team coach
articles.body:
'Fifth press conference by Luis de la Fuente in one week. The Spanish national team coach appeared in the press room at Oviedo’s home ground to talk about a match, the one against the Czech Republic , which pits him against two coaches with whom he has many ties: Santi Denia and Pablo Amo. '

' Withdrawals: "The drawback of this format is that there is little time to recover. We prioritize the player's health and prefer there to be a player in perfect condition".'

' The goalkeeper: "When we talk about rotations, we mean choosing the players who are in the best form for the match. In every position. Usually the goalkeeper position remains more consistent, but there can be a change in any position".'

Santi Denia and Pablo Amo: "We have just been with them. We know each other very well, but the ones who change matches are the footballers, the ones who give a different feel. They know how we play, but it is not easy to defend against us and you always have to keep an ace up your sleeve. I haven't told them everything I knew."

Lamine: "We will field the most suitable team for tomorrow's match. We have it in mind, but tonight we will give it the final touches. If he starts from the beginning, it is because we believe that is when he can be most influential. Every day he is more mature. It is a pleasure to watch him. He comes across as a person who accepts any suggestion. It is very good news".

' Spanish coaches: "It is all the result of training. You have to invest in footballers, but the ones who train them well are the good coaches. Coaches are increasingly better prepared".'

' The opponent: "There are no easy matches. You have to be excellent in every match. They are a very difficult opponent who can be a trap for those who do not know them, but they are not going to surprise us. A lot of people will be surprised when they see them".'

' Cristiano Case: "De la Fuente on the Cristiano mess: "I can't comment on it because I don't have the facts. Every situation is unique and unrepeatable"."

articles.title: An end to the war between Mbappé and PSG
articles.standfirst: The French courts dismiss the complaint filed by the Whites' No. 10 against the Parisian club for moral harassment, considering that there was insufficient evidence to proceed
articles.summary: The French courts dismiss the complaint filed by the Whites' No. 10 against the Parisian club for moral harassment, considering that there was insufficient evidence to proceed
articles.body:
French justice has dismissed the complaint that Kylian Mbappé filed against PSG for alleged psychological harassment during his final spell at the club . The investigation, opened after the footballer’s lawyers went to court, was ultimately closed in May due to insufficient evidence and after the player himself withdrew the complaint, according to French media.

"The origin of the case dates back to the summer of 2023, when Mbappé was left out of PSG's first team after communicating his decision not to renew his contract . The club believed that the player had to renew or leave the club in exchange for a significant amount of money before his contractual link ended and he could leave on a free transfer. For several weeks, Mbappé remained on the sidelines of the first team . Finally, he was reintegrated into the group and was able to compete again under Luis Enrique , who was then facing his first season in charge of the team.

A legal battle on several fronts

The sporting episode also ended up turning into a legal battle. After leaving PSG at the end of that season to join Real Madrid, the club withheld part of the salary and bonuses due to the player . PSG maintained that those amounts were linked to a verbal agreement reached between Mbappé and the club’s president, Nasser Al-Khelaifi , which would have allowed his return to the first team.

The player rejected that interpretation and claimed the outstanding amounts . In May 2025, he launched a legal offensive on several fronts, including the complaint for moral harassment related to his exclusion from the team. However, that complaint was later withdrawn by the footballer himself . The investigation continued for a time, but the investigating judges ultimately dismissed it due to the impossibility of moving forward with proceedings that no longer had the support of the complainant and because of the lack of sufficient evidence.

61 million euros and the end of the dispute

The other major legal front, the one related to the sums of money that PSG had withheld, ended with a ruling in Mbappé's favor. A Labor Court ordered the Parisian club to pay him 61 million euros . PSG decided not to appeal that ruling, so the decision became final. With the dismissal of the complaint for moral harassment, the legal disputes between Mbappé and PSG are now closed .

articles.title: Mexico vs. USA prediction: What do history and the latest numbers say about who has the edge?
articles.standfirst: The Concacaf Clasico returns with two national teams in new processes and recent numbers that make the matchup much harder to read at a glance.
articles.summary: The Concacaf Clasico returns with two national teams in new processes and recent numbers that make the matchup much harder to read at a glance.
articles.body:
F ew FIFA dates generate as much excitement among fans as a Mexico vs. USA matchup. This Saturday, October 3, both national teams will meet again at State Farm Stadium in Glendale , Arizona, in another chapter of a rivalry that already spans decades. But this time, there is something that makes the matchup even more interesting: Mexico enters a new process under Rafael Márquez, the United States continues its run with Mauricio Pochettino, and the numbers tell a different story when looking at the present compared with the overall head-to-head history.

Mexico is unbeaten, but still searching for its first win

Mexico's current form has one detail that is difficult to ignore. El Tri has yet to lose during this new chapter, but it also has not managed to win.

Its two most recent matches ended in draws: 1-1 against Colombia and 1-1 against Peru. In both games, Mexico had to respond to rescue the draw, meaning Márquez's team arrives at the Clasico with a particular mix of results: it has not lost , but it is still looking for the game that will mark its first victory under the new leadership.

For the United States, the immediate picture is different.

United States enters with two straight wins

The USMNT arrives after earning two consecutive victories in its preparation matches. First, it defeated Peru 4-1 and then beat Chile 4-2, two results that allow the U.S. to face Mexico with a winning streak .

But when the picture is widened a little, the story changes again.

The last five Mexico vs. USA matches are completely split

The five most recent meetings show a rivalry that is much more balanced than a single winning streak might suggest.

Mexico won two. The United States won two. And there was one draw.

United States 1-2 Mexico, July 6, 2025, Gold Cup final.

Mexico 2-0 United States, October 15, 2024, friendly.

Mexico 0-2 United States, March 24, 2024, Concacaf Nations League final.

United States 3-0 Mexico, June 15, 2023, Concacaf Nations League semifinal.

United States 1-1 Mexico, April 19, 2023, friendly.

There is also one detail that changes the way that list can be read: Mexico won the two most recent meetings, including a Gold Cup final . The United States, meanwhile, won the two matches before those, both in the Concacaf Nations League.

So the last five meetings do not produce a clear dominant side. They produce something much more interesting for this new chapter: a 2-2-1 record that leaves almost everything open.

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo's "like" that angers Portugal
articles.standfirst: The 41-year-old forward reacted to a post that criticized his teammates for the lack of support and respect they had shown him in recent days
articles.summary: The 41-year-old forward reacted to a post that criticized his teammates for the lack of support and respect they had shown him in recent days
articles.body:
Cristiano Ronaldo's chapter with the national team is far from over . Despite the fact that Portugal has recorded three victories in this Nations League, the controversy surrounding the forward's departure from the training camp continues to grow . And now there is a new element that has once again inflamed tempers in Portugal: Cristiano's own "like" on some statements that were very critical of his teammates.

The protagonist of those words was Felipe Melo, former Brazilian footballer, who lashed out at the attitude of the Portuguese footballers toward their captain. The Brazilian publicly questioned the lack of support and respect toward the 41-year-old forward in statements to Sportv.

You can't just let him leave as if nothing had happened

The video ended up on Instagram and quickly went viral. It has more than 27,000 "likes", but there was one that did not go unnoticed: Cristiano’s. An apparently simple gesture that has once again put the spotlight on the relationship between the captain and the rest of the Portuguese dressing room and that is generating discomfort and debate in the country.

Felipe Melo had put a particularly sensitive comparison on the table. According to the Brazilian, there is a notable difference between how Ronaldo’s teammates treat him and how Argentine footballers support Lionel Messi . In addition, he used Hojlund to illustrate the extent to which the Portuguese star remains a reference point for other players.

There is a grotesque difference in the way his Portuguese teammates treat Cristiano and the way Argentine players treat Lionel Messi

'" There is a grotesque difference in the way his Portuguese teammates treat Cristiano and the Argentine players treat Lionel Messi ," he began by saying.'

'Melo also highlighted the respect that, in his view, Ronaldo continues to command even among his own rivals. " I see much more respect from opponents when they play against Cristiano Ronaldo, and yesterday Hojlund got very angry with Jorge Jesus because his idol is Cristiano Ronaldo , rather than the Portuguese national team. That is wrong, because no one there comes close to Cristiano Ronaldo’s ankles. He cannot be allowed to leave like that as if nothing had happened ," he said.'

The fact that Cristiano "liked" this very message adds even more fuel to an issue that seemed destined to die down after his three victories with Portugal. His gesture, although not accompanied by any statement, has reopened the debate over what happened during the training camp and once again places the captain at the center of the conversation.

articles.title: Rafael Márquez brings out the heavy artillery against the United States: this would be the Mexican National Team's XI, with Gil Mora ready
articles.standfirst: "The Kaiser" rested his best players against Peru and now fields a luxury lineup for the Concacaf Clásico
articles.summary: "The Kaiser" rested his best players against Peru and now fields a luxury lineup for the Concacaf Clásico
articles.body:
Rafael Márquez has already shown his hand. In the debut against Colombia, he fielded his strongest eleven and secured a 1-1 draw. Against Peru he rotated almost the entire team to give minutes to other options. Now, against the United States , the scenario changes for the Mexican National Team . It is the team to beat in Concacaf and the Kaiser will put out his most competitive version .'

The lineup the Michoacán-born coach liked most was the one that faced the Colombians. Raúl “Tala” Rangel established himself between the posts, Johan Vásquez and Israel Reyes formed the central pairing, and Jesús Gallardo regained the left-back spot. In midfield, Erik Lira and Gilberto Mora brought balance and creativity, while Roberto Alvarado and Hirving Lozano stretched the field.

The return of the heavy artillery

Everything indicates that Márquez will recover most of those names. Tala Rangel would return to goal after Óscar García got his opportunity against Peru.

In defense, Jorge Sánchez , Israel Reyes , Johan Vásquez and Jesús Gallardo are shaping up as the chosen ones. Left back remains one of the most hotly contested positions, but Gallardo maintains the edge due to experience.

At the center of the field, Erik Lira appears to be a lock. The big question is Gilberto Mora .The Xolos youngster is finishing up recovery from an ankle issue, but his performance against Colombia placed him as one of the difference-making pieces of the new process. In his pre-match press conference, the Kaiser indicated that the highest probability is that Morita will play against the USA . If so, Mexico will have one of its aces up its sleeve to unsettle the American defense.

Key facts about the "war" between Mexico and the USA

Lineup vs Colombia: Rangel; Sánchez, Reyes, Vásquez, Gallardo; Lira, Chávez, Mora; Alvarado, Lozano, Hormiga

Lineup vs Peru: almost complete rotation

Possible XI vs USA : Rangel; Sánchez, Reyes, Vásquez, Gallardo; Lira, Mora, Chávez; Alvarado, Giménez, Lozano

Match: Saturday, October 3, 8:00 PM (CDMX)

Venue: State Farm Stadium, Glendale, Arizona

"Chaquito" Giménez as a penalty-area reference

In attack, Santiago Giménez has a strong chance of starting. The Porto striker did not start against Colombia or Peru , but the match against the United States is the ideal moment to give him the responsibility in the box . Roberto Alvarado on the right and Hirving Lozano on the left would complete a high-caliber front three .

Rafa Márquez wants the first win of his tenure and knows that the United States is the real benchmark . That is why, unlike the match against Peru, this time there will be no experiments. El Tri will take the field with the best it has available.

articles.title: Rafael Márquez puts an end to the mystery surrounding Gilberto Mora's injury against the United States
articles.standfirst: The coach of the Mexican National Team clarified Morita's availability for the Concacaf Clasico
articles.summary: The coach of the Mexican National Team clarified Morita's availability for the Concacaf Clasico
articles.body:
'Quite a mystery has surrounded Gilberto Mora , who did not see any minutes against Peru , and alarm bells went off over a supposed injury that had sidelined him in recent training sessions.'

However, Rafael Márquez put an end to the rumors and clarified Morita's physical condition, and whether we will see him back in the Mexico vs. the United States match.

In a press conference in Phoenix, the coach of the Mexican National Team provided an update on Morita 's physical condition, confirming that he has been being handled with kid gloves for days .

"Gil underwent routine tests due to some minor discomfort, but he is progressing positively," he noted.

'Given that, Rafael Márquez gave the most positive update on Gil Mora , since he will not be out for the Concacaf Clásico , although he did not reveal whether he will start, so "he is eligible for the next match" against the United States .'

Mexico and the bet on young people

On the other hand, Rafael Márquez said he is calm about the criticism leveled in the previous match against Peru , where he bet on young blood; however, he will not throw them into the fray in a match as tough as the one against the United States .

"No need, perhaps, in a match like this to have to put them in, which obviously I have no problem with. I already showed it against Peru, which is, despite it being Peru, was a very competitive team, a team with a lot of experience, and even so I fielded some different from the one that played the first match," he emphasized.

Adding that "the boys, in a certain way and generally speaking, behaved up to the mark and I have no doubt that they will also rise in a match like this one to the expectations I have of them," he said.

Mexico and the bet on young people

On the other hand, Rafael Márquez said he is calm about the criticism leveled in the previous match against Peru , where he bet on young blood; however, he will not throw them into the fray in a match as tough as the one against the United States .

"No need, perhaps, in a match like this to have to put them in, which obviously I have no problem with. I already showed it against Peru, which is, despite it being Peru, was a very competitive team, a team with a lot of experience, and even so I fielded some different from the one that played the first match," he emphasized.

Adding that "the boys, in a certain way and generally speaking, behaved up to the mark and I have no doubt that they will also rise in a match like this one to the expectations I have of them," he said.

articles.title: Zlatan Ibrahimovic turns his back on Leo Messi in the Ballon d'Or and his favorite will generate more controversy
articles.standfirst: The former Swedish footballer Zlatan Ibrahimovic once again became the center of the media spotlight after making forceful statements about who should be awarded the Ballon d'Or
articles.summary: The former Swedish footballer Zlatan Ibrahimovic once again became the center of the media spotlight after making forceful statements about who should be awarded the Ballon d'Or
articles.body:
Just a few days after France Football closed the official voting period for this season's award , the former Barcelona and AC Milan striker Zlatan Ibrahimovic made his stance clear regarding the most coveted individual distinction in global football .

'Despite the deep respect and shared history with Leo Messi at Camp Nou, Ibrahimovic preferred to distance himself from the figure of the Argentine star to side with the youth of Lamine Yamal . True to his direct and no-nonsense style, the Nordic justified his verdict by pointing out that the trophy should not be guided by the historical weight of a name, but by the real ability to make the difference and decide matches at the elite level.'

The words of the current rossoneri executive did not take long to shake up the global football ecosystem, reopening the eternal debate over which criteria should take precedence when assessing the best footballer on the planet. His firm stance places the Spanish winger at the center of all attention right on the eve of the gala .

The explicit bet on the young talent of Lamine Yamal

For Ibrahimovic, the natural recipient of the coveted award should be the young Blaugrana forward. The former player argued that the jewel of the Barcelona squad has been the most decisive figure on the international stage at an individual level , showing standout talent both in domestic fixtures and in his appearances for the national team.

'In statements reported by the specialized outlet Sportskeeda and circulated by international networks such as FOX Sports and beIN Sports, the Swedish icon justified his support for the Spanish gem. "The Ballon d'Or should be given to the player who truly makes the biggest difference individually; for me, Lamine Yamal did that and is the one who deserved it" , Zlatan asserted when analyzing the performance shown on the pitch.'

This stance by Ibrahimovic defies the predictions that place established figures like Kylian Mbappé or Erling Haaland at the top. With his argument, the Nordic legend leads a movement calling for a changing of the guard on the main international podiums .

A global debate backed by other legends

Zlatan's forceful assessment does not come in isolation, but rather aligns with the opinions expressed by other illustrious names in world football in the final stretch of the voting. Publications from various news outlets highlight that former figures such as the Cameroonian Samuel Eto"o have also agreed in pointing to the young academy graduate as the most dazzling footballer of today .

For his part, Lamine Yamal himself has preferred to maintain a calm tone in the face of the wave of praise received from legends of the sport. In recent statements given to European media, the young forward emphasized that his absolute priority remains collective growth and daily work , regardless of the media debates ahead of the France Football gala.

With the voting formally closed and the envelopes sealed, the mystery over who will lift the coveted golden sphere is getting closer and closer to being revealed. Meanwhile, Zlatan Ibrahimovic's words have added even greater anticipation to a ceremony that promises to be marked in recent football history .

articles.title: Pep Guardiola brings his own style to the streets of Paris ahead of Victoria Beckham’s fashion show
articles.summary: Pep Guardiola made an appearance in Paris ahead of Victoria Beckham’s fashion show, with a relaxed look that drew attention beyond the soccer world.
articles.body:
Pep Guardiola made an appearance in Paris ahead of Victoria Beckham’s fashion show, with a relaxed look that drew attention beyond the soccer world.

The clip captures Guardiola outside the event, chatting and posing for photos with fans. His understated outfit and easygoing demeanor prompted the person sharing the video to praise his “effortless style.”

Beckham presented her spring/summer 2027 collection on October 2 during Paris Fashion Week. The show took place at the historic Conciergerie, where guests included David Beckham and Eva Longoria.
